draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.45, the 20th-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 2nd of 36 at CB. He went 24th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Marshon Lattimore. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: his final season (2023) ranked 3rd in passes defended among the 34 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Seattle Seahawks (exempt). 24 career games and 22 starts over 2 completed seasons. Still developing: 3 AV in 2025. Played 8 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-2 cornerback who played: 28.3% season snap share against a median of 27.8%, above the norm.
